id: title:Piccirello:allow our own media in the app policy

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the Content Security Policy (CSP) media-src directive, potentially allowing the browser to load media resources from Cloudinary, self-origin, and blob/data URIs.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 replaces a single origin CSP directive with a comma-separated list including 'self', 'data:', 'blob:', and the Cloudinary origin. This is a configuration change to browser security headers.
review.uncertainty: The complete set of hunks is not available, so the full scope and implementation of this CSP change cannot be verified. The tier is assigned based solely on this single hunk, which represents a localized configuration update rather than a systemic architectural change. No evidence of broader implementation or testing is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single hunk. No other hunks are supplied, so no relationship between PRs can be established. No score is assigned. No tier is assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced media-src CSP directive from a single allowed origin to a comma-separated list including 'self', 'data:', and 'blob:', while retaining the original Cloudinary origin.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the browser to load media resources from the same origin, data URIs, blob URIs, and the Cloudinary CDN, while still blocking other external origins. This could support loading AI-generated media or other dynamic assets alongside the existing Cloudinary videos.
